references.text: God sets His face against those who sin; the same expression 'נָתַתִּי פָנַי' is used regarding God's judgment
Repeated use of the expression that God sets His face against sinners as a threat of judgment
Parallel curse: Israel shall be struck down before their enemies and flee from them
Describes how enemies pursue Israel when God has abandoned them
Fulfillment of the curse: Israel flees before their enemies at Ai
Israel is struck down before the Philistines, fulfilling this curse
Enemies rule over Israel as punishment from God
A thousand shall flee before one, parallel to fleeing without being pursued
God delivers His people into the hands of enemies who rule over them
